concept.reason: Actual cranial fossils and museum species description establish bounded reconstruction; no extra concept render.

scope: Complete massive flightless D. planei with very deep large skull/bill and robust long-legged body. Not D. stirtoni and not a skull-only model.

scientific_limits.en: Species height about2.5m and mass300kg are estimates, not measurements of either illustrated skull. NTM P9464-106 is a braincase, not complete head; NTM P932-2 is a separate rostrum with deformation and surface cavitation. Do not reconstruct its distortion as normal anatomy.2024 study questions extreme narrowness inferred from compressed rostra. Exact whole body proportions, feet, small wings, feathers and colors are comparative soft-tissue restoration. Do not combine D.stirtoni3m/500kg or Australian Museum header illustration with D.planei.
scientific_limits.zh: 约2.5米/300公斤为物种估计，不是两件所示颅标本实测。NTM P9464-106仅颅脑壳；另件NTM P932-2喙有变形空蚀，不复制为正常形态。2024研究质疑压扁标本推得极窄喙。全身比例、足、微小翼、羽毛及颜色属比较复原。不混D.stirtoni三米五百公斤或博物馆页首另一物种插图。

classification: Aves, Dromornithidae, Galloanserae; precise galliform/anseriform position debated, recent cranial study favors anseriform affinity.

scale.model_status: All living model dimensions are restoration estimates; scale bars are genuine source graphic calibrations, not measured full-head length.

diagnostic_targets: Very large deep short head and high curved bill, unlike low goose-like Genyornis or long spear penguin bill.
Maintain rounded high dorsal bill profile and strong lower jaw; do not reproduce cavitation, cracks or extreme compressed side width.
Long substantial curved neck entering massive deep body, not an ostrich with tiny head.
Robust long supporting hind limbs and broad forward toes; no webbing, no mammal paws.
Strong flightless silhouette with tiny inferred wings against body and short feathered rear contour.
Full standing bird, no3m D.stirtoni scaling, no fossil slab or skull-only downgrade.
acceptance: Original massive deep skull and robust long-legged complete body present.
Side proves deep high curved beak, long neck and sturdy legs; front/top prove non-paper-thin head and paired feet.
NTM P9464-106 and P932-2 are separate skull components/specimens, not one measured complete individual.
Use neutral estimated feather colors; no horn, casque or pathological surface inferred solely from damaged rostrum.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review.
